description:
Evolved to be more enjoyable on your summer bikepacking trips and weekend gravel grinds. With a revised gravel focused geometry, this year’s Provincial Trail 2 makes your time in the saddle more comfortable and more efficient. Built on fast rolling 700C wheels wearing plush 45mm tires, this bike delivers the grip and comfort of a gravel bike and the potential speed of a road bike. Equipped with SRAM’s 12 speed Apex groupset, you get tons of mechanical advantage to help flatten out the climbs. By moving to a 1x12 drivetrain, we’ve removed a potential point of failure in the front — the derailleur — giving you the durability mountain bikers have enjoyed for years. Powerful hydraulic disc brakes keep your velocity right where you want it, regardless of the weather or trail conditions. While the Provincial Trail is outfitted with everything you need for your next gravel epic, the Trail 2 is also a great performer on your weekday commute, because we all have to earn those vacation days somehow.

Light and strong 6000-series aluminum frame has a stable trail-ready geometry.

Internal cable routing uses alloy cable-stops that allow you to customize your setup and add a dropper post should you wish to do so

Carbon fibre fork reduces weight and offers a smoother ride.

Front fork features fender mounts and internal cable routing for a clean and snag-free look

Frame is equipped with eyelets for fenders, racks, bottle cages and bag mounts

12x100mm thru-axle fork and 12x142mm frame makes it easy to switch between these adventure-ready wheels and road-specific ones

Frame and fork clearance allows for tires that measures up to 50mm in width

SRAM Apex 1x12 gruppo yields fast shifts and solid braking in a lightweight package.

DoubleTap system, shifting up or down is done with a with short sweep of your fingers

SRAM Apex hydraulic disc brakes provide outstanding power and modulation regardless of weather

SRAM Apex 1 crankset uses X-Sync™ chainring technology for excellent chain retention in rough terrain.

WTB ST i23 rims are tubeless ready and designed for the rigours of gravel grinds

WTB Vulpine tires are tubeless ready are a fast rolling hybrid of a race-focused cyclocross tire and a grippy gravel tire. Tightly spaced centre lugs reduce rolling resistance and encourage straight line speed, while tightly packed shoulder lugs grab in the corners and on loose terrain.

Fizik Terra Argo X7 is 150mm wide, has a short nose and wave profile for efficient power delivery and comfort on rough terrain

Part of MEC’s Provincial collection – a versatile series of bags and bikes that are just as useful on your commute, as they are on your gravel grinds and bikepacking adventures

Bikes are covered by MEC's Rocksolid Guarantee and Bike Service Agreement. You can bring your bike to any MEC bike shop for free adjustments and minor maintenance for a year after purchase

MEC bikes are designed in Canada. Everything from the frames to the graphics are developed at the MEC Head Office in Vancouver, BC

Due to challenges with supply chain, components may be substituted for comparable parts at any time. The listed build is how MEC intended your bike to arrive, though the manufacturer may need to make a tweak or two to get you riding sooner
